description: Return public data source freshness status and affected routes. savings is an alias for hysa; money-market is an alias for mma. Also supports cds, checking, macro, bank-gap-index, and indices. Omit category for all supported sources. Unknown categories return an error; a source with no observations is explicitly unavailable. Source collection freshness does not establish that a ranked deposit release is approved or current.

category.description: Optional freshness category. savings maps to hysa; money-market maps to mma. Also supports cds, checking, macro, bank-gap-index, and indices. Omit for all supported sources. Unknown values return an error; a known source without observations is unavailable.

name: get_rate_freshness

generatedAt.description: ISO timestamp this response was computed at.

title: Data Freshness
